description: nsq: run several AI coding agents in your terminal and get called when one needs you.
notes: Start with 'nsq' (dashboard) or 'nsq run claude "task"'. Your own Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode
logins and configs are used as they are; nsq never writes them.

script: # The npm tarball holds nsq itself; its dependencies (prebuilt native addons included) come
# from the npm registry. No install scripts run: every addon must ship a prebuild.
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "npm install failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }
